slug: 2025-07-25 RFP - Eswatini National Data Policy (Smart Africa)

facts.fact: Smart Africa issued a request for proposals (RFP# 131/SA/RFP/07/2025, budget US$70,000, closing 25 August 2025) to procure the writing of an Eswatini national data policy; the source describes the policy as at procurement stage, not yet drafted, and nothing adopted.

note: Source page is a short excerpt; no body, rule or adoption is stated.
